entries.t: <FACE:08>This is…!
<FACE:00>What's wrong, Hiyori?<NL>
<FACE:04>Medafighter ranking<NL>data, huh…<NL>
<FACE:00>What about it?
<FACE:06>Look closer, <PLAYER>!
<FACE:03>Two ranking lists…?<NL>These two lists…!!
<FACE:05>See it?<NL><WAIT>On this list here<NL><WAIT>that smug Medafighter<NL>Shiden never shows up<WAIT>but on that one Shiden<NL>sits right at the top<WAIT>Know what that means?
<FACE:03>Huh? But…<NL>that can't be…
<FACE:06>The data was rewritten<NL><WAIT>And the culprit… well,<NL>there's little doubt
<FACE:04>But one Medafighter,<NL>acting alone…<WAIT>couldn't rewrite the<NL>rankings that easily<WAIT>Right?

<FACE:05>Well, yeah…<NL><WAIT>True, this alone isn't<NL>proof enough<WAIT><FACE:06>We'll have to ask the<NL>man himself…<WAIT><FACE:01>For now, taking back<NL>control comes first<WAIT><FACE:04>Right, that's…
<FACE:04>It's bugging me, but…

<FACE:05>Let's leave that part<NL>to them<WAIT>I don't know how much<NL>help they'll be…<WAIT>And Shiden seems to be<NL>here too<WAIT>We've got nowhere else<NL>to go<WAIT>so we'd come to the<NL>Computer Block<WAIT>He'd figure that much,<NL>right?<WAIT>If he faked the data,<NL>wouldn't he hide it?
<FACE:04>Shiden…<NL>
<FACE:04>(Shiden… back when he<NL> showed me <MEDABOT>…)<NL><WAIT>(He said «our RR<NL> Company»…)
<FACE:05>Right, let's split up<NL>You right, me left<WAIT>Dawdle and the proof<NL>gets erased too
<FACE:04>(If he's RR staff…)
<FACE:05>(Not bad, he's trying)<NL>
<FACE:05>(«Staff Only», huh…)<NL>
<FACE:05>(By now we're not just<NL> staff, we're in it.)
<FACE:08>(Oh?)<NL>
<FACE:05>(Hmm…)<NL><WAIT>(RR VIP Card No. 0001<DELAY:001E><NL> «Murasame Shiden»<DELAY:000A>…)<WAIT>(That's as good as<NL> saying «I did it»…)
<FACE:07>What are you doing?
<FACE:12>…Oh, it's you, Hiyori.<NL>
<FACE:11>I see, I left the card<NL>key in. How careless.
<FACE:06>I asked what you're<NL>doing here!
<FACE:0F>My, what a temper.<WAIT><FACE:0F>When we first met…<NL><WAIT>I took you for a more<NL>ladylike young miss.
<FACE:06>I don't need YOU to<NL>think me ladylike!<WAIT>Answer the question!
<FACE:0F>Then I needn't answer.<NL>Yes, I am…<WAIT><FACE:01>Shiden!
<FACE:0F>That an unranked<NL>Medafighter like you<WAIT>would get this far…<NL><WAIT>I never saw it coming.<NL>
<FACE:12>The Cluster adrift,<NL>for one…<WAIT><FACE:10>Event after event my<NL>figures never saw.
<FACE:01>Do you work for RR?

<FACE:11>Heh. A slip of the<NL>tongue.<WAIT><FACE:0F>I as good as told you<NL>myself.<WAIT>That, and the card key<NL>I left behind…<WAIT>A situation I never<NL>planned for has me<WAIT>completely rattled.<NL>Careless of me.
<FACE:01>What are you to RR?
<FACE:10>So many questions…<WAIT><FACE:0F>Fine, I'll answer,<NL>just this once.<WAIT>Whether you believe it<NL>is up to you.
<FACE:06>Quit stalling and<NL>answer!
<FACE:0F>Then let me ask you…<NL><WAIT>If I said that I…<NL><WAIT>really run RR itself,<NL>would you believe me?
<FACE:03>What!?
<FACE:0F>What is it?<NL><WAIT>If you have something<NL>to say, say it.
<FACE:05>It does sound hard to<NL>believe.<WAIT>But faking the data<WAIT>and sitting at the top<NL>of the ranking<WAIT>forever…<WAIT>only the owner could<NL>do that, sure enough.
<FACE:0F>Nothing is beyond a<NL>net business genius.
<FACE:05>For a genius, you<NL>hid it pretty badly.
<FACE:11>Heh… not really.<NL><WAIT><FACE:0F>You two are the only<NL>ones who know.<NL>
<FACE:0F>And the Cluster is<NL>adrift as we speak.<WAIT>By the time control<NL>comes back, I'll have<WAIT>wiped every trace of<NL>the tampering myself.
<FACE:0F>…So who will they<NL>believe, you or me?<WAIT><FACE:11>With the proof gone,<NL>your story is just<WAIT>sour grapes at a top<NL>ranker. Nothing more.
<FACE:06>Why, you coward!
<FACE:04>Shiden… does this<NL>really make you glad?<WAIT><FACE:10>Glad? Hmph.<NL>
<FACE:0F>I don't follow.
<FACE:01>I'm the one who<NL>doesn't follow.<WAIT><FACE:01>Going that far<NL><WAIT>just to top the rank -<NL>is that fun?<WAIT>I'd hate that.
<FACE:0F>You know nothing but<NL>pretty words, boy…<WAIT><FACE:10>A fight you don't win<NL>is meaningless.<WAIT>Drop the soft talk<NL>or stay a loser.
<FACE:06>Ugh, you make me so<NL>angry!<WAIT>That way of thinking<NL>is the loser talking!<WAIT>Don't you get it!?
<FACE:03>H-Hiyori, Hiyori!
<FACE:0F>Heh… no matter.<WAIT>I have plenty of time,<NL>and nobody stops me.
<FACE:06>Hey, wait!
<FACE:00>Hiyori…
<FACE:06>What?
<FACE:04>I don't get the hard<NL>stuff,<WAIT>and maybe I really am<NL>a naive kid.
<FACE:01>But as a fellow<NL>Medafighter,<WAIT>I think you're wrong.
<FACE:0F>And?
<FACE:01>Our Medabots will say<NL>who's right!<WAIT>Let's Robattle,<NL>Shiden!
<FACE:11>Hmph.<NL><WAIT><FACE:0F>Such simple, carefree<NL>thinking. Not for me.
<FACE:10>Who are you?
<FACE:14>Ah! There they are!
<FACE:03>Wh-what do you want?<WAIT><FACE:08>Weren't you messing<NL>with the computer?
<FACE:14>Our leader's gone and<NL>vanished on us!
<FACE:19>He was with us just<NL>a moment ago, y'know<WAIT><FACE:14>Thought you lot might<NL>have seen him.
<FACE:00>I didn't see him.<WAIT><FACE:05>Me neither.
<FACE:11>Well, well…<NL><WAIT>quite the crowd you've<NL>gathered.
<FACE:14>Oi, that's right! You!<NL>Seen our leader?<WAIT><FACE:1A>Hiding things won't do<NL>you any good-robo!
<FACE:0F>Let me think…
<FACE:06>What are you up to?
<FACE:11>A little game.<NL><WAIT>It would be a shame<NL>not to use the system<WAIT>they have here.
<FACE:00>Which is?

<FACE:0F>The «Watchball».<WAIT>It has an AI and a<NL>Medawatch inside,<WAIT>so it can command a<NL>Medabot in a<WAIT>Robattle.<WAIT>One ball controls<NL>exactly one Medabot.<WAIT>…An AI Medafighter, if<NL>you like.<WAIT>So: by the official<NL>rules of the RR<WAIT>tournament, we fight<NL>five against five.<WAIT><FACE:11>As I am alone, I will<NL>use four Watchballs.<WAIT>No objections?
<FACE:15>Oi, oi, this guy just<NL>decides everything!<WAIT>We're busy looking for<NL>our leader!<WAIT>Go bother someone<NL>else!<WAIT><FACE:1A>That's right-robo!
<FACE:01>Fine, we'll take those<NL>rules. We won't lose!
<FACE:17>O-oi, what? Just like<NL>that…<WAIT><FACE:1C>Nobody told us-robo!
<FACE:05>He's the top ranker<NL>of the whole ranking.<WAIT><FACE:07>Beat him and you can<NL>brag forever[<3]
<FACE:19>W-well, when you put<NL>it that way-robo…
<FACE:14>Right! We beat him and<NL>the leader sees us!
<FACE:07>(So easy to handle[<3])
<FACE:0F>Ready, it seems.<NL>Then let us begin…
<FACE:10>Tch…
<FACE:06>Well?<WAIT>I don't know who you<NL>think you are,<WAIT>but we'll never lose<NL>to someone who thinks<WAIT>faking data counts as<NL>winning.
<FACE:17>Faking data? What's<NL>that about?<WAIT><FACE:1A>So the top of the rank<NL>was a lie-robo?

<FACE:04>Shiden…<WAIT>Do you know why you<NL>lost?<WAIT>You are strong, but<NL>the way you fight has<WAIT>no feeling for your<NL>Medabots at all.<WAIT>With a Medafighter<NL>like that,<WAIT>Medabots can't give<NL>everything they have.<WAIT><FACE:01>Leaning on Watchballs<NL>in a Robattle is bad!
<FACE:10>And that is meant to<NL>persuade me?
<FACE:0F>This round may well<NL>be yours.
<FACE:10>But remember this:<NL>I win in the end.
<FACE:06>Ah, wait!
<FACE:06>Why did you stop me!?<NL><WAIT>Leave him and he'll go<NL>wipe the proof of the<WAIT>tampering somewhere<NL>else!<WAIT>This isn't the only<NL>terminal, you know!
<FACE:01>Stopping him now is<NL>useless.<WAIT>Unless he changes how<NL>he thinks,<WAIT>he'll only do it<NL>again.
<FACE:06>But it's not right!<WAIT><FACE:02>It's fine, Hiyori.<NL>I'll change him.
<FACE:09>Sheesh. Where does he<NL>get that from?
<FACE:08>Right, we must take<NL>back this Block…
<FACE:05>That's the panel.
<FACE:53>Management computer<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0006><NL>«Navi» rebooting.<DELAY:003C><DELAY:0014><END>
<FACE:53>System check…<WAIT><FACE:02>Yes!<WAIT><FACE:00>Now we can see how the<NL>Cluster is doing!
<FACE:53>The Cluster is far off<NL>its proper orbit<WAIT>and must be corrected<NL>at once…<WAIT><FACE:00>We know that, Navi.<NL>What do we do now?

<FACE:53>80 percent of the<NL>Cluster's Blocks are<WAIT>cut off and cannot be<NL>reached…<WAIT>Automatic network<NL>rebuild will not run…<WAIT>Rebuilding requires<NL>each Block's control<WAIT>unit to be restarted<NL>by hand.
<FACE:08>All the way to the<NL>edge of the Cluster?
<FACE:09>Haaaaaah…
<FACE:53>I cannot allow that.<NL><WAIT>While each Block's<NL>state is unknown,<WAIT>I cannot put guests<NL>in danger.
<FACE:08>What!<WAIT><FACE:06>Then how do we ever<NL>get back to Earth!
<FACE:01>She's right, Navi!<NL><WAIT>And there are friends<NL>of ours still trapped<WAIT>further in! Worry for<NL>them, not for us…
<FACE:53>Worry?<NL><WAIT>No such parameter is<NL>defined.<WAIT>Under the guest care<NL>rules, I…
<FACE:05>Rules? So do those<WAIT>rules say to leave<NL>guests in a Block<WAIT>whose<WAIT>state you don't know?
<FACE:53>No…<NL><WAIT>Rescuing guests is the<NL>highest priority.<WAIT>But rescue work is for<NL>Cluster staff…
<FACE:00>Then make us temporary<NL>staff!<WAIT><FACE:53>That is…
<FACE:08>That's it! <PLAYER>,<NL>send out <MEDABOT>!<WAIT><FACE:03>Huh? Oh… right.
<FACE:05>Look at this Medabot!<WAIT>Your boss, Murasame<NL>Shiden, gave it to<WAIT>us!<WAIT>Which makes him and<NL><PLAYER> partners!<WAIT>Well?<WAIT>Still not making us<NL>staff?
<FACE:53>True… that Medabot is<NL>an unreleased model…
<FACE:03>(Hiyori! Us, partners?<NL> That's a lie!)
<FACE:06>(It's fine! It's just<NL>a computer!)<WAIT><FACE:04>(Computer or not,<NL>lying is wrong.)<WAIT>(She's a friend who<NL>looks after us…)
<FACE:53>…<WAIT>…Understood.<WAIT>You are approved as<NL>temporary staff for<WAIT>rescue work.<WAIT>I will customise your<NL>Medawatches so we can<WAIT>talk inside the<NL>Cluster.
<FACE:07>We can talk to her!
<FACE:05>(See? Being good<NL>pays…)<WAIT><FACE:06>(You can't get by on<NL>pretty words alone!)
<FACE:04>(But…)<WAIT><FACE:53>…
<FACE:8E>In any case the<NL>management computer<WAIT>is up… at least the<NL>worst is over.
<FACE:03>Ah! The great Medabot<NL>professor!?<WAIT><FACE:8E>Mm… and your name?

<FACE:00>I'm <PLAYER>.<WAIT>Temporary class rep of<NL>the class trapped in<WAIT>the Cluster…<WAIT><FACE:03>Ah!<WAIT><FACE:00>And just now we became<NL>temporary Cluster<WAIT>staff!<WAIT><FACE:8F>Temporary? …never<NL>mind…<WAIT><FACE:8E>This is the Medabot<NL>research lab.<WAIT>Quite the situation<NL>you are in…<WAIT>For our research we<NL>asked RR to help us,<WAIT>and we are linked by a<NL>special comms system.<WAIT>This line alone seems<NL>to still reach you…

<FACE:04>Professor… about RR…<WAIT><FACE:8E>Mm… they appear to be<NL>up to something.<WAIT>For now this line<WAIT>had better be kept<NL>from RR.<WAIT><FACE:00>Yes, please do.<WAIT><FACE:8E>Navi's report told me<NL>how things stand<WAIT>there.<WAIT>What worries me are<NL>the Blocks you can't<WAIT>reach! The Cluster<NL>went adrift because<WAIT>someone<WAIT>fired the orbit<NL>correction engine,<WAIT><FACE:8F>and whoever did it<NL>must still be hiding.<WAIT><FACE:00>So the drifting really<NL>wasn't an accident!<WAIT><FACE:8E>Still…<WAIT>even without full<NL>control restored,<WAIT>most of the Cluster's<NL>functions should<WAIT>work.<WAIT>We'll support you from<NL>here,<WAIT>so I must ask you all<NL>to do your best…
<FACE:00>Understood!<NL>Thank you, professor.<WAIT><FACE:8E>For now, that room has<NL>Medals and Tinpets.<WAIT>Use them to build up<NL>your strength.<WAIT><FACE:00>Yes, sir!

<FACE:8E>And…<NL><WAIT>further on there are<NL>«Rooms» that develop<WAIT>Medabots. Station your<NL>friends and run them<WAIT>and you'll get parts<NL>still in development.<WAIT>Use those as well.<WAIT><FACE:00>The newest parts!<NL>That's a big help!
<FACE:19>Leader!<WAIT><FACE:14>We've been looking<NL>for you!
<FACE:00>Fubuki, where were<NL>you?
<FACE:0A>Nowhere…<NL><WAIT>Just looking something<NL>up.<WAIT>I searched for a way<NL>to take back control<WAIT>of the Cluster, but<NL><FACE:0E>there's nothing.
<FACE:04>Hmm, I see…
<FACE:05>No use moping now.<NL>Let's press on.
<FACE:04>This is it…<NL><WAIT><FACE:01>Let's hurry!<NL>Hiyori and I go here!<WAIT>Fubuki and the rest,<NL>take the other side<WAIT><FACE:0A>Got it
<FACE:0A>Hm?
<FACE:0A>What's this…?
<FACE:05>Oh, a flower petal?<NL>What's it doing here?
<FACE:00>Hey, what's wrong,<NL>Fubuki? Let's go.
<FACE:0D>Ah… yeah…
